# Reinforcement learning

For new RL, RLVR or GRPO work with supported Olmo MoE models, use
`python -m open_instruct.miles` and follow [the MILES guide](docs/miles/grpo.md),
including its launch checks and configuration conventions. Existing Core/vLLM
(`grpo.py`) and DeepSpeed/vLLM (`grpo_fast.py`) workflows remain current alternatives
for dense-model training; see [their guide](docs/algorithms/grpo.md).
Choose according to model and workload support, preserve the user's selected
workflow, and identify support gaps explicitly. MILES does not deprecate the
existing GRPO trainers.

For MILES GPU runs on `ai2/jupiter` or `ai2/saturn` (CUDA 12.8 host drivers), keep
the pinned MILES image: RunSpec defaults `launch.env.LD_LIBRARY_PATH` to the image's
CUDA compatibility libraries, and an explicit value wins. Revalidate CUDA
initialization and a short training run when the image or driver changes. See
[Jupiter CUDA compatibility](docs/miles/launching.md#jupiter-cuda-compatibility).

# Bash commands
- `uv run pytest`: Run the tests.
- `make style && make quality` run the linter + formatter.
- `uv run mkdocs serve`: View the documentation locally at http://127.0.0.1:8000/
- `uv run mkdocs build`: Build the documentation to the `site/` directory.



## Code Review Rules

Read and follow [CODE_REVIEW.md](CODE_REVIEW.md) when reviewing code.

# Workflow
- Begin every GitHub comment published by an agent with one plain line naming the agent (e.g. Codex, Claude Code): `Drafted by {agent name}.`, with no alert or other formatting. If a person reviewed the response before publication, use `Drafted by {agent name} and reviewed by {reviewer's name}.` instead. Only include the review attribution when that person actually reviewed the response; permission to post alone does not count as review.
- When a PR changes anything under `open_instruct/`, add a summary to `CHANGELOG.md` with a link to the PR (e.g., `- Description of change (https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/123).`). This is what CI enforces; PRs touching only `scripts/`, docs, or config are exempt, though an entry is still welcome for anything user-visible.
  - The entry must contain the PR's own URL, which does not exist until the PR is opened. Add the entry, open the PR, then amend the entry with the URL and push again.
  - To skip the check deliberately, put `CHANGELOG=<reason>` in the PR body.
- Always run the linter and make sure the tests pass before finishing a task.
- Prefer running single tests, not the whole suite, when developing.
- Launch Beaker experiment and test scripts with `./scripts/train/build_image_and_launch.sh [--cuda-version 12|13] SCRIPT` after committing all changes. CUDA 13 images are for compatible clusters such as `ai2/holmes`. MILES uses `--miles CONFIG` and its pinned runtime.
- For the Core/vLLM and DeepSpeed/vLLM GRPO workflows, we have three test scripts (for MILES checks, follow `docs/miles/architecture.md`):
  - `scripts/train/debug/single_gpu_on_beaker.sh`: single GPU, no tools (~8 minutes).
  - `scripts/train/debug/tools/olmo_3_parser_multigpu.sh`: multi GPU, with tools.
  - `scripts/train/debug/large_test_script.sh`: two 8x GPU nodes, no tools (~32 minutes).
- For OLMo-core SFT, we have two test scripts:
  - `scripts/train/debug/oc_sft.sh`: single GPU on Beaker.
  - `scripts/train/debug/oc_sft_multinode.sh`: two 8x GPU nodes on Beaker.
- For DPO, we have three test scripts:
  - `scripts/train/debug/dpo/local.sh`: local single GPU (no Beaker).
  - `scripts/train/debug/dpo/single_gpu.sh`: single GPU on Beaker.
  - `scripts/train/debug/dpo/multi_node.sh`: two 8x GPU nodes on Beaker.
- Launch the GPU tests with `./scripts/train/build_image_and_launch.sh scripts/test/run_gpu_pytest.sh`.
- CI runs on GitHub-hosted runners without Beaker experiments or image publication. Run GPU tests manually when a change touches GPU code paths. Record `GPU_TESTS=[EXPERIMENT_ID](https://beaker.org/ex/EXPERIMENT_ID)` in the PR body for reviewers; CI does not parse or verify this line, and `GPU_TESTS=bypass` has no effect. The experiment must actually run `scripts/test/run_gpu_pytest.sh`; record training/debug smoke runs separately. Existing `open_instruct_auto*` images are no longer refreshed by CI; build from the intended revision with the launcher.
- If you are given a Beaker URL (`beaker.org` or `beaker.allen.ai`), use the Beaker CLI tool to interact with it.
- When a Beaker job stays queued or pending, run `beaker job events <job-id>` before diagnosing why — it prints the scheduler's own reason; don't infer one from cluster documentation. If that reason is the workspace slot limit, it applies to every cluster at once: wait or request fewer GPUs rather than relaunching elsewhere.
- A Beaker experiment can hold several jobs when a preempted one is retried. Read the most recently created attempt for each task and replica rank, not `jobs[0]` or one latest job for the entire experiment, or a successful retry looks like a failure and missing replicas can be overlooked.
- Mason's `--min_runtime <duration>` sets Beaker's `minRuntime` (0, or a duration with a unit of at least 5m, such as `30m`; Ai2 clusters currently allow at most 8h), and `--auto_resume` sets `autoResume`. On allocation-scheduled clusters, a job with a min runtime above 0 is allocated: it queues ahead of backfill and is protected until its min runtime ends, and shorter min runtimes schedule sooner. Its workspace needs an allocation on that cluster, or Beaker rejects it at submission. The legacy `--preemptible` switch, which cannot be combined with `--min_runtime`, maps to `minRuntime: 0` and `autoResume: true`; such unallocated jobs run only as backfill and may wait indefinitely. Passing neither flag maps to an eight-hour protected, non-resumable job, the hardest kind to schedule. Prefer a realistic `--min_runtime` (the time the job needs to reach a checkpoint), and call out this choice before launching instead of silently copying a checked-in script's choice.
- On macOS, GRPO launch scripts that call `mason.py` need `--no_auto_dataset_cache` (before the `--` separator). Local dataset caching runs the training entrypoint with `--cache_dataset_only`, and `grpo.py` / `grpo_fast.py` still import vllm at module level (`grpo_fast.py` from `vllm.distributed.weight_transfer`, `grpo.py` via `vllm_utils`), which is not installed on Darwin. `finetune.py`, `dpo.py`, `dpo_tune_cache.py` and `reward_modeling.py` no longer import vllm on this path since [#1866](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/1866), so their scripts do not need the flag. `mason.py` prints a macOS hint but still attempts caching, so it does not protect you either way.
- The `oe-eval-internal` directory is required in the Docker image for experiments that use `--try_launch_beaker_eval_jobs_on_weka`. If it's missing (e.g. in a fresh clone or worktree), clone it with: `git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/allenai/oe-eval-internal.git oe-eval-internal`.
- When updating PR bodies with experiment results, use the "Runs:" format (numbered list with Beaker links):
  ```
  Runs:

  1. Description: [Beaker](https://beaker.org/ex/EXPERIMENT_ID)
  2. Description: [Beaker](https://beaker.org/ex/EXPERIMENT_ID)
  ```

# Naming conventions
- Models OLMo and OLMo 2 (versions <=2) use the "OLMo" capitalization style.
- Olmo 3, Olmo Hybrid, and later models use "Olmo" (standard proper noun capitalization).
- Note: "OLMo-core" refers to the software repository and keeps its original capitalization.

# Coding conventions
- Never use `import logging` or `logging.info()` directly. Always use `logger = logger_utils.setup_logger(__name__)` and `logger.info()`.
- Imports always go at the top of the file, never inline.
- Use `from package import module` instead of `import package.module`.

# Documentation
To verify that documentation changes don't alter the generated output:

If a person reviewed the response before publication, use `Drafted by {agent name} and reviewed by {reviewer's name}.` instead. Only include the review attribution when that person actually reviewed the response; permission to post alone does not count as review.

This is what CI enforces; PRs touching only `scripts/`, docs, or config are exempt, though an entry is still welcome for anything user-visible.
  - The entry must contain the PR's own URL, which does not exist until the PR is opened. Add the entry, open the PR, then amend the entry with the URL and push again.
  - To skip the check deliberately, put `CHANGELOG=<reason>` in the PR body.

- Prefer running single tests, not the whole suite, when developing.
- Launch Beaker experiment and test scripts with `./scripts/train/build_image_and_launch.sh [--cuda-version 12|13] SCRIPT` after committing all changes. CUDA 13 images are for compatible clusters such as `ai2/holmes`. MILES uses `--miles CONFIG` and its pinned runtime.

  - `scripts/train/debug/tools/olmo_3_parser_multigpu.sh`: multi GPU, with tools.
  - `scripts/train/debug/large_test_script.sh`: two 8x GPU nodes, no tools (~32 minutes).

  - `scripts/train/debug/oc_sft.sh`: single GPU on Beaker.
  - `scripts/train/debug/oc_sft_multinode.sh`: two 8x GPU nodes on Beaker.

  - `scripts/train/debug/dpo/local.sh`: local single GPU (no Beaker).
  - `scripts/train/debug/dpo/single_gpu.sh`: single GPU on Beaker.
  - `scripts/train/debug/dpo/multi_node.sh`: two 8x GPU nodes on Beaker.

The experiment must actually run `scripts/test/run_gpu_pytest.sh`; record training/debug smoke runs separately. Its workspace needs an allocation on that cluster, or Beaker rejects it at submission. The legacy `--preemptible` switch, which cannot be combined with `--min_runtime`, maps to `minRuntime: 0` and `autoResume: true`; such unallocated jobs run only as backfill and may wait indefinitely. Passing neither flag maps to an eight-hour protected, non-resumable job, the hardest kind to schedule. Prefer a realistic `--min_runtime` (the time the job needs to reach a checkpoint), and call out this choice before launching instead of silently copying a checked-in script's choice.
- On macOS, GRPO launch scripts that call `mason.py` need `--no_auto_dataset_cache` (before the `--` separator).  
  ```
  Runs:

  1. Description: [Beaker](https://beaker.org/ex/EXPERIMENT_ID)
  2. Description: [Beaker](https://beaker.org/ex/EXPERIMENT_ID)
  ```

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in messages from the system in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

prompt.description: The task for the agent to perform

subagent_type.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task

model.description: Optional model override for this agent. Takes precedence over the agent definition's model frontmatter and the configured default subagent model. If omitted, uses the agent definition's model, else the default (inherits from the parent unless a default subagent model is configured). Ignored for subagent_type: "fork" — forks always inherit the parent model.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

delaySeconds.description: Seconds from now to wake up. Clamped to [60, 3600] by the runtime. Required unless `stop` is true.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the chosen delay. Goes to telemetry and is shown to the user. Be specific. Required unless `stop` is true.

prompt.description: The /loop input to fire on wake-up. Pass the same /loop input verbatim each turn so the next firing re-enters the skill and continues the loop. For autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` instead (the dynamic-pacing variant, not the CronCreate-mode `<<autonomous-loop>>`). Required unless `stop` is true.

stop.description: Set to true to end the dynamic loop immediately instead of scheduling another wakeup. When true, all other fields are ignored and no further wakeups fire.

noop.description: true = nothing changed (you checked and there is nothing to report). false = something happened worth keeping (edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, surfaced a finding). Consecutive noop:true ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak. Required unless `stop` is true.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a listing from the system with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

skill.description: The name of a skill from the available-skills list. Do not guess names.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in a message from the system. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

query.description: Query to find deferred tools. Use "select:<tool_name>" for direct selection, or keywords to search.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a message from the system confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a message from the system confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

script.description: Self-contained workflow script. Must begin with `export const meta = { name, description, phases }` (pure literal, no computed values) followed by the script body using agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase().

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

title.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. Every Workflow invocation persists its script under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with the same `scriptPath` instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script` and `name`.

resumeFromRunId.description: Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. Completed agent() calls with unchanged (prompt, opts) return their cached results instantly; only edited or new calls re-run. Same-session only. Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.

For new RL, RLVR or GRPO work with supported Olmo MoE models, use
`python -m open_instruct.miles` and follow [the MILES guide](docs/miles/grpo.md),
including its launch checks and configuration conventions. Existing Core/vLLM

For MILES GPU runs on `ai2/jupiter` or `ai2/saturn` (CUDA 12.8 host drivers), keep
the pinned MILES image: RunSpec defaults `launch.env.LD_LIBRARY_PATH` to the image's

# Bash commands
- `uv run pytest`: Run the tests.
- `make style && make quality` run the linter + formatter.
- `uv run mkdocs serve`: View the documentation locally at http://127.0.0.1:8000/
- `uv run mkdocs build`: Build the documentation to the `site/` directory.



## Code Review Rules

Read and follow [CODE_REVIEW.md](CODE_REVIEW.md) when reviewing code.

# Workflow
- Begin every GitHub comment published by an agent with one plain line naming the agent (e.g. Codex, Claude Code): `Drafted by {agent name}.`, with no alert or other formatting. If a person reviewed the response before publication, use `Drafted by {agent name} and reviewed by {reviewer's name}.` instead. Only include the review attribution when that person actually reviewed the response; permission to post alone does not count as review.
- When a PR changes anything under `open_instruct/`, add a summary to `CHANGELOG.md` with a link to the PR (e.g., `- Description of change (https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/123).`). This is what CI enforces; PRs touching only `scripts/`, docs, or config are exempt, though an entry is still welcome for anything user-visible.
  - The entry must contain the PR's own URL, which does not exist until the PR is opened. Add the entry, open the PR, then amend the entry with the URL and push again.
  - To skip the check deliberately, put `CHANGELOG=<reason>` in the PR body.
- Always run the linter and make sure the tests pass before finishing a task.
- Prefer running single tests, not the whole suite, when developing.
- Launch Beaker experiment and test scripts with `./scripts/train/build_image_and_launch.sh [--cuda-version 12|13] SCRIPT` after committing all changes. CUDA 13 images are for compatible clusters such as `ai2/holmes`. MILES uses `--miles CONFIG` and its pinned runtime.
- For the Core/vLLM and DeepSpeed/vLLM GRPO workflows, we have three test scripts (for MILES checks, follow `docs/miles/architecture.md`):
  - `scripts/train/debug/single_gpu_on_beaker.sh`: single GPU, no tools (~8 minutes).
  - `scripts/train/debug/tools/olmo_3_parser_multigpu.sh`: multi GPU, with tools.
  - `scripts/train/debug/large_test_script.sh`: two 8x GPU nodes, no tools (~32 minutes).
- For OLMo-core SFT, we have two test scripts:
  - `scripts/train/debug/oc_sft.sh`: single GPU on Beaker.
  - `scripts/train/debug/oc_sft_multinode.sh`: two 8x GPU nodes on Beaker.
- For DPO, we have three test scripts:
  - `scripts/train/debug/dpo/local.sh`: local single GPU (no Beaker).
  - `scripts/train/debug/dpo/single_gpu.sh`: single GPU on Beaker.
  - `scripts/train/debug/dpo/multi_node.sh`: two 8x GPU nodes on Beaker.
- Launch the GPU tests with `./scripts/train/build_image_and_launch.sh scripts/test/run_gpu_pytest.sh`.
- CI runs on GitHub-hosted runners without Beaker experiments or image publication. Run GPU tests manually when a change touches GPU code paths. Record `GPU_TESTS=[EXPERIMENT_ID](https://beaker.org/ex/EXPERIMENT_ID)` in the PR body for reviewers; CI does not parse or verify this line, and `GPU_TESTS=bypass` has no effect. The experiment must actually run `scripts/test/run_gpu_pytest.sh`; record training/debug smoke runs separately. Existing `open_instruct_auto*` images are no longer refreshed by CI; build from the intended revision with the launcher.
- If you are given a Beaker URL (`beaker.org` or `beaker.allen.ai`), use the Beaker CLI tool to interact with it.
- When a Beaker job stays queued or pending, run `beaker job events <job-id>` before diagnosing why — it prints the scheduler's own reason; don't infer one from cluster documentation. If that reason is the workspace slot limit, it applies to every cluster at once: wait or request fewer GPUs rather than relaunching elsewhere.
- A Beaker experiment can hold several jobs when a preempted one is retried. Read the most recently created attempt for each task and replica rank, not `jobs[0]` or one latest job for the entire experiment, or a successful retry looks like a failure and missing replicas can be overlooked.
- Mason's `--min_runtime <duration>` sets Beaker's `minRuntime` (0, or a duration with a unit of at least 5m, such as `30m`; Ai2 clusters currently allow at most 8h), and `--auto_resume` sets `autoResume`. On allocation-scheduled clusters, a job with a min runtime above 0 is allocated: it queues ahead of backfill and is protected until its min runtime ends, and shorter min runtimes schedule sooner. Its workspace needs an allocation on that cluster, or Beaker rejects it at submission. The legacy `--preemptible` switch, which cannot be combined with `--min_runtime`, maps to `minRuntime: 0` and `autoResume: true`; such unallocated jobs run only as backfill and may wait indefinitely. Passing neither flag maps to an eight-hour protected, non-resumable job, the hardest kind to schedule. Prefer a realistic `--min_runtime` (the time the job needs to reach a checkpoint), and call out this choice before launching instead of silently copying a checked-in script's choice.
- On macOS, GRPO launch scripts that call `mason.py` need `--no_auto_dataset_cache` (before the `--` separator). Local dataset caching runs the training entrypoint with `--cache_dataset_only`, and `grpo.py` / `grpo_fast.py` still import vllm at module level (`grpo_fast.py` from `vllm.distributed.weight_transfer`, `grpo.py` via `vllm_utils`), which is not installed on Darwin. `finetune.py`, `dpo.py`, `dpo_tune_cache.py` and `reward_modeling.py` no longer import vllm on this path since [#1866](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/1866), so their scripts do not need the flag. `mason.py` prints a macOS hint but still attempts caching, so it does not protect you either way.
- The `oe-eval-internal` directory is required in the Docker image for experiments that use `--try_launch_beaker_eval_jobs_on_weka`. If it's missing (e.g. in a fresh clone or worktree), clone it with: `git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/allenai/oe-eval-internal.git oe-eval-internal`.
- When updating PR bodies with experiment results, use the "Runs:" format (numbered list with Beaker links):
  ```
  Runs:

  1. Description: [Beaker](https://beaker.org/ex/EXPERIMENT_ID)
  2. Description: [Beaker](https://beaker.org/ex/EXPERIMENT_ID)
  ```

- Models OLMo and OLMo 2 (versions <=2) use the "OLMo" capitalization style.
- Olmo 3, Olmo Hybrid, and later models use "Olmo" (standard proper noun capitalization).
- Note: "OLMo-core" refers to the software repository and keeps its original capitalization.

# Coding conventions
- Never use `import logging` or `logging.info()` directly. Always use `logger = logger_utils.setup_logger(__name__)` and `logger.info()`.
- Imports always go at the top of the file, never inline.

2	
3	> 本讲对应 MILES 单元第三讲。上一讲（u8-l2）我们已经看过 TOML run 文件如何被 `RunSpec` 「加载即编译」成 `RunConfig`；本讲顺着这条链往下走：**编译产物交给谁、在 GPU 集群上如何被执行、中断之后如何恢复、一次 run 何时才算「完成」、以及训练开始前有哪些启动期预检**。本轮增量更新（bae4209 → 8cd7c9eb）为 driver 新增了 `rewards.validate_registry` 启动预检（PR #2250 统一判分输入的一部分），本讲把它作为 driver 协调循环的第一环纳入讲解。
4	
5	## 1. 本讲目标
6	
7	学完本讲，你应该能够：
8	
9	1. 说出一次 MILES run 的三个阶段（准备 / 训练 / 导出）各自的输入输出，以及哪些阶段在中断后可以复用、哪些必须重算。
10	2. 解释「指纹（fingerprint）」如何支撑 resume：配置身份如何计算、哪些字段的改动被允许、哪些会被拒绝。
11	3. 读懂 `driver.train` 的协调循环：启动期预检 → rollout 收集 → 优化器更新 → 权重发布 → 存档边界，以及时间停 / debug 退出 / 池耗尽三种提前退出方式。
12	4. 理解 run 完成判定如何使用 driver 返回值中的 `num_rollout`：`training.num_epoch` 预算的 run 由原生运行时在数据加载后才解析出 rollout 总数，并通过 `core.save_final_checkpoint` 在最后一次更新时落盘最终存档。
13	5. **掌握本轮更新**：`driver.train` 在分配任何 worker 之前调用 `rewards.validate_registry`——解析可信判分注册表、为每个验证器计算 grading 策略，拒绝未声明输入契约的外部验证器或不兼容的 reasoning 约定。
14	6. 理解 `cluster.Supervisor` 如何在 Beaker 副本内做受监管启动（心跳、健康探针、启动预算）。

16	## 2. 前置知识
17	
18	- **run 文件与 RunSpec（承接 u8-l2）**：一份 TOML 描述模型、数据、训练器、推理引擎与集群分配；`RunSpec.compile()` 把结构化小节翻译成 `CoreConfig`（经 `--olmo-core-config` 传入）和原生 MILES 参数（`--num-rollout`、`--num-epoch` 等）。本讲取其中与「训练预算」「存档节奏」和「判分输入声明」相关的编译产出。
19	- **rollout（采样回合）**：GRPO 类算法以「一轮采样 + 若干次优化器更新」为基本节奏。一轮收集 `rollout_batch_size × n_samples_per_prompt` 条回答，`global_batch_size` 决定每次更新消耗多少条。
20	- **可信判分注册表（承接 u8-l6）**：MILES 的奖励不是数据自带的任意代码。`core.reward_config` 指向一份注册表 JSON，把验证器名映射到 `{factory, config, kwargs}` 工厂规格；打分时按样本元数据里的 `verifiers` 名单从注册表取验证器。u8-l12 在此之上定义了每个验证器的 grading 输入契约（objective × scope × require_response）。本讲只关心一件事：**driver 在启动时如何预检这份注册表**。
21	- **幂等与指纹**：分布式训练会被抢占、被重启。为了让重启后的进程能安全复用上一轮的产物，系统给每个产物记录「身份」（输入的哈希或清单），重启时先核对身份，一致才复用——这就是指纹。
22	- **Beaker 副本（replica）**：MILES 的多机 run 会被 Beaker 调成多个副本，每个副本在各自节点上跑一个 `cluster` 进程；其中 IP 最小的节点成为 head，只有 head 运行训练 workflow。
23	- **原生运行时（pinned MILES runtime）**：open-instruct 通过 `--miles` 镜像使用一版钉死的 MILES/Core 运行时。数据集加载、rollout 引擎与优化器执行都发生在那个运行时里；open-instruct 侧的 driver 只做编排。

40	## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解
41	
42	### 4.1 workflow 阶段与指纹恢复
43	
44	#### 4.1.1 概念说明
45	
46	`workflow.py` 回答的问题是：**「一份 run 规格，如何变成磁盘上一组可恢复的产物？」** 它把一次 run 划分为三个阶段：
47	
48	1. **准备（prepare）**：把模型源转换/暂存成 HF 目录、把数据准备成带验证目标的提示集，并给两个产物各写一份「身份清单」。
49	2. **训练（train）**：把编译好的配置交给 driver（见 4.2）执行。
50	3. **导出/收尾**：driver 返回结果字典，workflow 据此把 run 状态写成 `complete` 或 `stopped`。
51	
52	「指纹」是这一切的安全网：run 目录里记录了启动时规格的哈希，重启时新规格必须与记录匹配（或在允许的「运维字段」上等价），否则拒绝恢复，逼你换一个新的 `output.root`。这防止了「换数据续训旧目录」这类静默事故。
53	
54	#### 4.1.2 核心流程
55	
56	```text
57	execute(spec)
58	  │
59	  ├─ run_directory(spec)            # 独占锁 + 身份校验 + attempt 记账
60	  │    ├─ flock(.workflow.lock)     # 多进程互斥
61	  │    ├─ fingerprint(spec) == 旧 spec_sha256 ?  # 否则按白名单归一化后再比
62	  │    ├─ 旧 status == complete ? → 拒绝（已完成 run 不可覆盖）
63	  │    └─ auto_resume=false 且目录已存在 ? → 拒绝
64	  │
65	  ├─ 阶段1 准备：prepare_model → prepare_data → 判分注册表校验
66	  │    （模型/数据产物带身份清单，resume 时直接复用）
67	  │
68	  ├─ 阶段2 训练：auto_resume 且有 core-latest.json → 挂载 load；
69	  │    train_config() → parse_runtime() → driver.train()
70	  │
71	  └─ 阶段3 收尾：按结果字典判定 complete / stopped，写 workflow.json
72	```
73	
74	指纹的数学定义很直接——对规格字典做「按键排序后的 JSON 序列化」再取 SHA-256：
75	
76	\[
77	\mathrm{fingerprint}(d) = \mathrm{SHA256}\big(\mathrm{json\_dumps}(d,\ \mathrm{sort\_keys}=\text{true})\big)
78	\]
79	
80	注意 `sort_keys=True` 保证了同一逻辑规格（字典键顺序不同）得到同一指纹。
81	
82	#### 4.1.3 源码精读
83	
84	**run 目录的锁与身份校验**。[open_instruct/miles/execution/workflow.py:306-346](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/workflow.py#L306-L346) 是 `run_directory` 上下文管理器：先用 `fcntl.flock` 对 `.workflow.lock` 加非阻塞独占锁（防止两个进程同时写同一 run 目录）；然后计算当前规格的指纹，与 `workflow.json` 里记录的 `spec_sha256` 比对；若旧状态是 `complete` 直接拒绝（完成的 run 不可覆盖）；若 `launch.auto_resume=false` 且目录已有 workflow 也拒绝。任何阶段抛异常时，把状态更新为 `failed` 并记录错误再上抛。

129	#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案
130	
131	**练习 1**：为什么 `recovery_configuration_matches` 允许改 `training.save_interval`，却不允许改 `training.num_epoch`？
132	**答案**：`save_interval` 只影响「未来产物的节奏」，不改变已经训出的权重语义；而 `num_epoch` 属于训练视野（horizon）——改了它等于改变这次 run 要训多少数据，与目录里已记录的指纹身份冲突。源码注释明确写了「Keep training horizon, evaluation tasks/scorers, and all recipe fields strict」（[workflow.py:86-88](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/workflow.py#L86-L88)）。
133	
134	**练习 2**：一个 run 在第 3 次被抢占后重启，`launch.max_retries=2`，会发生什么？
135	**答案**：`record_attempt` 读到 `attempts.json` 已有 3 条记录，`len(attempts) > limit`（3 > 2）成立，抛出 `InputError`，提示要么调大 `launch.max_retries` 要么换新 `output.root`（[workflow.py:119-125](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/workflow.py#L119-L125)）。注意上限按「重启次数」计，首次启动不会被拒。
136	
137	**练习 3**：为什么 `model_identity` 不对 safetensors 权重整体做 SHA-256？
138	**答案**：权重动辄几十 GB，每次启动都全量哈希会把恢复拖慢到不可用。它退而记录（路径, 大小, mtime_ns）三元组，只对小体积的配置/模板文件做内容哈希——以极小概率漏检「同大小同时间的权重替换」换取可用的启动速度（[workflow.py:131-149](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/workflow.py#L131-L149)，函数 docstring 自述 "without hashing tens of GB"）。
139	
140	### 4.2 driver 协调循环
141	
142	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
143	
144	`driver.py` 的 `train()` 是**一次训练尝试（attempt）**的协调者。它自己不执行模型前向、不搬运权重——那些属于钉死的 MILES 运行时（SGLang 推理引擎 + OLMo-core 训练器）。driver 的职责是把各角色连起来并在正确的时机放置边界：
145	
146	- **启动期预检（本轮新增）**：在分配任何 worker 之前校验判分注册表的输入契约；
147	- rollout 收集（推理引擎按当前策略采样）；
148	- 优化器更新（训练器消费一个 batch）；
149	- 权重发布（把训练器的新权重推给推理引擎，支持 barrier / refresh / engine-drain 三种模式）；
150	- 存档边界（周期存档、最终存档、哨兵文件触发）；
151	- 评估与后台评估的分发；
152	- 无论成功失败都要做的有序清理。
153	
154	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
155	
156	`driver.train` 的主干可以概括成下面的伪代码（省略 async 细节）：
157	
158	```text
159	train(args):
160	    校验 Ray 后端
161	    若配置了 reward_config 且 custom_rm_path 指向 open-instruct 奖励入口:
162	        validate_registry(args)            # ← 本轮新增：worker 分配前的注册表预检
163	    解析时间预算 max_run_seconds → deadline；判定时间停是否可恢复(resumable)
164	    启动 Ray → 初始化 W&B → 启动 worker manager
165	    （colocate/offload 时序约束下）启动 serving 与 trainer；拿到 rollouts_per_epoch
166	    首次权重发布 publish()；等待 judge 就绪
167	    for rollout_id in range(start_rollout_id, num_rollout):     # ← 主循环
168	        batch = manager.get(rollout_id)            # 池耗尽则存档并 break
169	        learner.train(rollout_id, batch)           # 优化器更新
170	        completed.append(rollout_id)
171	        若满足存档条件: manager.save + learner.save_model + finalize_checkpoint
172	        若 refresh 模式 / 到更新间隔: publish(rollout_id)
173	        若到评估间隔: evaluation.dispatch(rollout_id)
174	        若到时间预算: break（resumable 与否决定 final_stop）
175	        若 debug_exit_after_rollout 达到: break
176	    收尾：评估 drain、最终 HF 导出、后台评估 final 分发
177	    finally：按序清理（prepared batch → 生成停止 → 权重传输关闭 → 各角色 dispose）
178	    return {completed_rollout_ids, num_rollout, pools_exhausted, ...}
179	```
180	
181	存档条件的判定（对应 [driver.py:306-324](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/driver.py#L306-L324)）是四项的析取：
182	
183	\[
184	\text{save} \iff (\text{到时且可存}) \ \lor\ \text{sentinel} \ \lor\ (\text{save\_final\_checkpoint} \land \text{最后一个 rollout}) \ \lor\ \text{周期 interval 到达}
185	\]
186

249	#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案
250	
251	**练习 1**：时间停（`max_run_seconds` 到达）什么时候算 run 完成、什么时候算可恢复中断？
252	**答案**：driver L65 `resumable = not max_run_final and bool(save)`。有存档路径且未设 `max_run_final` 时，时间停保存后 break，返回 `stopped_for_time=True, time_stop_resumable=True`，workflow 判定为 `stopped`（可 resume）；反之 `final_stop=True`，会做最终导出，workflow 判定为 `complete`。
253	
254	**练习 2**：为什么 debug 退出（`debug_exit_after_rollout`）不触发最终 HF 导出？
255	**答案**：L351-353 注释说明：debug 停留下的是「可恢复的 workflow」；如果第一个进程创建了最终导出目录，被 resume 的第二个进程就无法把自己的新权重导到同一目录（导出器是独占的）。所以导出条件是 `reached_end or final_stop`，debug 停两者都不满足。
256	
257	**练习 3（本轮更新）**：为什么 `validate_registry` 必须发生在 worker 分配（`wiring.launch_worker_manager`）之前，而不是推迟到第一次打分时才发现问题？
258	**答案**：三个理由层层递进。（1）**时序**：调用点在 `ray.init`、worker manager、W&B 初始化之前（[driver.py:43-48](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/driver.py#L43-L48) 早于 [driver.py:94-103](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/driver.py#L94-L103)），失败时不留任何需要清理的资源。（2）**成本**：若推迟到打分期，GPU 已分配、模型已加载、SGLang 引擎已起，错误在深达数分钟到数小时的初始化之后才出现，且每个打分 worker 都会各自失败一次。（3）**可观测性（最关键）**：有些契约违规不是异常而是**静默错判**——外部验证器在 final-only 模式下二次切分思考边界会拿到空输入，奖励全零、零方差组被过滤、训练空转，打分期根本不会「发现」（[rewards.py:343-346](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/rewards/rewards.py#L343-L346) 注释里点名的 qualified-IF 全零事故）。预检把这类错误变成启动期的显式 `ValueError`。

260	### 4.3 完成判定与最终存档：epoch 预算如何被判定为 complete
261	
262	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
263	
264	此前的更新引入了 **epoch 预算**：研究者可以用 `training.num_epoch = N` 声明「把数据训 N 遍」，而不必先算出这对应多少个 rollout。这带来两个必须解决的工程问题：
265	
266	1. **完成判定**：workflow 之前拿 `config.miles["num_rollout"]` 与完成计数比对。epoch 预算的编译产物里**故意没有** `num_rollout`（数据集没加载，总数未知），旧的比较永远比不出「到达终点」。解法：原生运行时在数据加载后把解析出的总数写回 `args.num_rollout`，driver 在返回字典里带上它，workflow 优先使用返回值。
267	2. **最终存档**：rollout 预算的 run 靠 `save_interval`（默认等于 `num_rollout`，即只在结尾存一次）拿到最终权重；epoch 预算没有这个锚点，于是新增 `core.save_final_checkpoint`，由编译器默认置真，driver 在最后一个 rollout 落盘。
268	
269	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
270	
271	```text
272	TOML [training] num_epoch=2
273	   │ run_spec.py L551-552 兜底 put("miles.num_epoch")（num_epoch 不在 FIELD_MAP/CORE_FIELDS）
274	   ▼
275	miles.num_epoch=2，且 miles.num_rollout 不存在
276	   │ L736-740：两者同设 → InputError；只设 epoch → 不再默认补 num_rollout=100
277	   ▼
278	L788-795：save_checkpoints=true（默认）且无 num_rollout
279	   → core.save_final_checkpoint = True（不发明周期 save_interval）
280	   ▼
281	RunConfig.arguments()：--num-epoch 2（无 --num-rollout）；
282	save_final_checkpoint 随 --olmo-core-config JSON 进入 args.olmo_core
283	   ▼
284	原生运行时加载数据集 → 解析 num_epoch 为 num_rollout（写入 args.num_rollout）
285	   ▼
286	driver 主循环跑满 num_rollout：L311 在最后一个 rollout 存档
287	   ▼
288	driver 返回 {"num_rollout": args.num_rollout, ...}
289	   ▼
290	workflow.execute：completed[-1]+1 == result["num_rollout"] → status=complete
291	```
292	
293	#### 4.3.3 源码精读
294	
295	**预算二选一**。[open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py:736-740](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py#L736-L740)：`num_epoch` 与 `num_rollout` 同时设置直接 `InputError`（"Choose num_epoch or num_rollouts; MILES would otherwise ignore num_epoch"——防止用户以为 epoch 生效实际被忽略）；只设 `num_epoch` 时**不再**补默认 `num_rollout=100`（旧版这个默认值无条件写入，正是 epoch 预算此前不可用的原因）。
296	
297	**存档节奏的编译**。[open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py:788-797](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py#L788-L797)：`save_checkpoints=true` 时——有 `num_rollout` 则 `save_interval` 默认取它（只在结尾存）；否则（epoch 预算）`core.setdefault("save_final_checkpoint", True)`，L793-794 注释写明「Native MILES resolves the epoch budget after loading the dataset. Save the final update without inventing a periodic cadence here.」`save_checkpoints=false` 与显式 `save_interval` 冲突报错；与 `max_run_seconds` 组合则把时间停标记为终局（`max_run_final=True`，无可恢复之物）。
298	
299	**新 CoreConfig 字段**。[open_instruct/miles/configuration/config.py:84-85](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/config.py#L84-L85)：`save_final_checkpoint: bool = False`，注释定位为「epoch 派生预算、无周期存档节奏时的 driver 策略」；它在 [config.py:239-264](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/config.py#L239-L264) 的布尔字段校验表中（L244），并经 [config.py:819-840](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/config.py#L819-L840) 的 `arguments()` 随 `--olmo-core-config` 的 JSON 传给运行时，最终出现在 driver 眼中的 `args.olmo_core.save_final_checkpoint`。`num_epoch` 的正整数校验在 [config.py:649-651](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/config.py#L649-L651)（`0`、负数、`true` 都被拒——注意 Python 里 `True` 是 `int`，所以这里显式检查 `type(...) is not int`）。
300	
301	**driver 侧的最终存档与返回值**（已在 4.2.3 展开，这里只点名）：[driver.py:311](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/driver.py#L311) 的第三个存档触发条件与 [driver.py:437-445](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/driver.py#L437-L445) 返回字典中的 `num_rollout`。
302	
303	**workflow 的完成判定**。[open_instruct/miles/execution/workflow.py:413-423](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/workflow.py#L413-L423)：
304	
305	```python
306	completed = result.get("completed_rollout_ids") if result else None
307	complete = (
308	    completed is None
309	    or bool(result.get("pools_exhausted"))
310	    or (bool(result.get("stopped_for_time")) and not result.get("time_stop_resumable"))
311	    or (
312	        (completed[-1] + 1 if completed else result["start_rollout_id"])
313	        == result.get("num_rollout", config.miles.get("num_rollout"))
314	    )
315	)
316	```
317	
318	四个条件的语义：① driver 没有报告完成清单（视为完成，兼容旧返回）；② 命名池耗尽（数据用尽即目标达成）；③ 不可恢复的时间停（终局停）；④ 完成计数 +1 达到总数。**关键在第④项右侧**：`result.get("num_rollout", config.miles.get("num_rollout"))`——driver 返回的、由原生运行时在数据加载后解析出的总数优先；编译配置里的 `num_rollout` 只是旧运行时的回退。epoch 预算 run 正是靠第④项右侧的新值被正确判为 complete。判定后 [workflow.py:424-425](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/workflow.py#L424-L425) 把 `complete`/`stopped` 与整个结果字典写进 `workflow.json`——而 4.1 里「已 complete 的 run 不可重启」正是消费这个状态。
319	
320	**测试佐证**。[open_instruct/test_miles_epoch_budget.py:10-36](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/test_miles_epoch_budget.py#L10-L36) 是这条链的验收：`num_epoch=2` 编译后 `miles["num_epoch"]==2` 且**没有** `num_rollout`；argv 含 `--num-epoch` 不含 `--num-rollout`；`compiled.core.save_final_checkpoint` 为真且无 `save_interval`；`training.num_rollouts` 与 `num_epoch` 并存、`num_epoch ∈ {0,-1,True}` 均抛 `ValueError`；`save_checkpoints=false` 时 `save_final_checkpoint` 不再默认为真。

351	
352	**练习 1**：为什么 workflow 不干脆在编译时把 `num_epoch` 换算成 `num_rollout`？
353	**答案**：换算需要知道 rollout 数据集的长度（每个 epoch 含多少个 rollout），而数据集在**准备/加载之后**才知道大小——编译发生在 CPU 提交机上，连数据都可能没挂载（`plan` 阶段不要求路径存在）。源码注释直接陈述了这个分工：「Native MILES resolves the epoch budget after loading the dataset」（[run_spec.py:793-794](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py#L793-L794)）。
354	
355	**练习 2**：一个 epoch 预算 run 在最后一个 rollout 保存了最终权重。如果磁盘上这个存档损坏，resume 会发生什么？
356	**答案**：`execute` 只在 `core-latest.json` 存在时才挂载 `load`（[workflow.py:396-398](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/workflow.py#L396-L398)）；损坏的存档在原生运行时加载时报错，本次 attempt 失败、状态记为 `failed`。由于完成状态依赖 driver 实际跑完（而不是存档存在），它不会被误判为 complete。
357	
358	**练习 3**：`result.get("num_rollout", config.miles.get("num_rollout"))` 为什么要保留后面的回退项？
359	**答案**：driver 与 workflow 可能来自不同版本的运行时（例如旧镜像里 driver 的返回字典还没有 `num_rollout` 字段）。此时回退到编译配置里的 `num_rollout`——rollout 预算 run 的值编译时已确定，行为与旧版完全一致。这是「新字段优先、旧字段兜底」的兼容式演进。
360	
361	### 4.4 Supervisor 启动监管
362	
363	#### 4.4.1 概念说明
364	
365	`cluster.py` 回答的问题是：**「一个 Beaker 副本内，如何把 Ray、judge 服务和训练 workflow 安全地拉起来，并在任何一方挂掉时让全体有序失败？」** `Supervisor` 是每个副本各一个的监管线程 + 子进程管理者，它提供四样东西：
366	
367	- **启动预算（startup budget）**：rank 0 发布一个统一的 deadline，所有后续启动工作（inventory、judge、Ray、workflow）共享这一个时钟；
368	- **心跳**：每 2 秒写 `heartbeat-{rank}.json` 并检查对端心跳，超时即失败——这是「对端节点消失」的检测器；
369	- **子进程监管**：被监管子进程非零退出、judge 连续 3 次健康探针失败，都会让本副本失败；
370	- **失败可见化**：失败写 `failed-{rank}.json`，对端在 `check()` 里发现即跟着失败。
371	
372	#### 4.4.2 核心流程
373	
374	```text
375	run(config)                                  # 每个 Beaker 副本一个进程
376	  ├─ 编译 + topology.plan；校验副本数/排名与提交一致
377	  ├─ rendezvous.join(output.root/cluster/<attempt>, rank, count)
378	  │    → 每次启动进入全新 attempt 目录（旧的 attempt 留档）
379	  ├─ Supervisor(...)：rank0 写 startup.json（唯一 deadline）；其余副本等它出现
380	  ├─ 心跳线程启动；SIGTERM/SIGINT → 抛错（让清理路径执行）
381	  ├─ 各副本写 node-{rank}.json → 等全部到齐 → topology.assign 得到本机分工
382	  ├─ GPU inventory 校验（可见设备数 == 计划数）；rollout GPU 还要过 profile 硬件校验
383	  ├─ 按分工起 judge 服务（各占自己的 GPU），端点写盘；head 额外占 3 个 Ray 端口
384	  ├─ ray start --block（head 带 --head，worker 带 --address）
385	  └─ head：start_workflow（ray-readiness/judge-readiness 两个探针任务 + driver 子进程）
386	     其余：等 complete.json → 各写 done-{rank}.json → head 收到全部 done 后收尾
387	```
388	
389	#### 4.4.3 源码精读
390	
391	**Supervisor 的构造与启动预算**。[open_instruct/miles/execution/cluster.py:80-107](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/cluster.py#L80-L107)：rank 0 把 `deadline = now + startup_timeout` 写进 `startup.json`，其余副本轮询该文件直到出现（超时即失败）——**整个集群对「启动要多久」只有一个预算**，避免各副本各算各的。
392	
393	**心跳线程**。[open_instruct/miles/execution/cluster.py:109-154](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/cluster.py#L109-L154)：每 2 秒写自己的心跳、检查对端心跳与子进程、按需探针 judge 健康。`check_peer_heartbeats` 有两个值得注意的细节：共享文件系统上的瞬时缺文件不算对端死亡（保留最后一次观测值，但不延长其期限）；心跳超过 `heartbeat_timeout` 即抛错。被监管子进程退出码非零同样抛错——但仅当 `complete.json` 还不存在（训练完成后的退出不是故障）。
394	
395	**judge 健康探针**。[open_instruct/miles/execution/cluster.py:156-184](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/cluster.py#L156-L184)：judge 服务在真正 HTTP 200 之前只算「待就绪」并受启动 deadline 约束；进入稳态后每次探针失败计一次，**连续 3 次**失败才判死——容忍单次网络抖动。
396	
397	**check / wait**。[open_instruct/miles/execution/cluster.py:195-227](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/cluster.py#L195-L227)：`check()` 汇总所有失败源（自身线程异常、startup 任务退出、对端 `failed-*.json`）并转发子进程日志；`wait()` 在 deadline 内轮询谓词，每 30 秒打一条「还在等」的警告。注意 L206-209 的注释：**显式 timeout 只用于训练后的完成等待**——训练阶段不受启动 deadline 约束（那会误杀长训练），由 Beaker 的 run timeout 与心跳兜底。
398	
399	**run：从 rendezvous 到 workflow**。[open_instruct/miles/execution/cluster.py:270-411](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/cluster.py#L270-L411)：
400	
401	- L283-289：以 `OI_MILES_LAUNCH_ID` 为 attempt 标识 `rendezvous.join` 到全新目录；
402	- L301-306：等所有 `node-{rank}.json` 到齐后由 `topology.assign` 定分工（head 取 IP 最小者）；
403	- L307-317：本机 GPU inventory 必须与 Beaker 分配一致，rollout GPU 还要过推理 profile 的硬件校验；
404	- L331-349：judge 服务逐个拉起（`SGLANG_EXTERNAL_MODEL_PACKAGE` 被特意移除——judge 是标准 Qwen 模型而非 Olmo 扩展），端点写入 `judge-{name}.json` 并汇入注册表环境变量；
405	- L357-392：`ray start --block`，head 与 worker 参数不同；
406	- L394-405：**只有 head 调用 `start_workflow` 并写 `complete.json`**；其余副本轮询 `complete.json`，最后全体各写 `done-{rank}.json`，head 等全部 done 再停 Ray——保证没有副本在 head 收尾时还在用 Ray。
407	
408	**start_workflow：准备与就绪解耦**。[open_instruct/miles/execution/cluster.py:414-427](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/cluster.py#L414-L427)：head 用 `start_task` 拉起两个**有限期**探针子进程（`--probe` 查 Ray 布局、`--probe-judges` 查 judge 就绪与 canary，见 [cluster.py:430-470](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/cluster.py#L430-L470)），同时用 `run_child` 运行 `python -m open_instruct.miles train <config>`——即 4.1/4.2 的 workflow+driver。driver 在 `judge_readiness_wait` 阶段（[driver.py:193-196](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/driver.py#L193-L196)）等这些探针放行，期间可以并行做模型/数据准备。
409	
410	#### 4.4.4 代码实践
411	
412	**实践目标**：源码阅读型实践——推演「一个 worker 副本心跳超时」的故障传播路径。
413	
414	1. 假设副本 1 的节点在训练中途失联。从 [cluster.py:125-154](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/cluster.py#L125-L154) 出发，写出传播链。
415	2. 再回答：head 的 driver 此刻在做什么？它能否感知？（提示：driver 的 `ray_readiness_wait` 只在启动期；训练期对端失联靠谁发现？）
416	3. **需要观察的现象**（纸上推演）：心跳线程抛 `RuntimeError("Replica 1 heartbeat expired")` → `self.failed` 被置位 → 主循环下一次 `supervisor.check()` 抛出 → `run` 的 `except` 写 `failed-0.json` → 对端（如果还活着）的 `check()` 读到 `failed-*.json` 也失败 → Beaker 层面任务失败，触发重试（`auto_resume` 时回到 4.1 的指纹恢复流程）。
417	4. **预期结果**：任何单副本失联都会在 `heartbeat_timeout` 内让全体副本失败，且 `cluster/<attempt>/` 下留下 `failed-{rank}.json` 与心跳文件作为尸检证据。
418	5. 无集群环境，属源码阅读型实践，结论**待本地验证**（可对照 `docs/miles/workflow.md` 的 "A killed process may leave the last recorded workflow state" 一节，[docs/miles/workflow.md:72-79](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/docs/miles/workflow.md#L72-L79)）。
419	
420	#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案
421	
422	**练习 1**：为什么 startup deadline 由 rank 0 统一发布，而不是各副本各自计算？
423	**答案**：各副本启动时刻略有先后，若各自算 deadline，先启动的先到期，会出现「A 认为 B 超时而 B 认为自己还有时间」的分歧。统一预算（[cluster.py:84-93](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/cluster.py#L84-L93)）让所有副本对「启动窗口何时关闭」有一致视图。
424	
425	**练习 2**：`start_task` 与 `start(..., monitor=True)` 有什么区别？为什么 ray-readiness 用前者、driver 用后者（`run_child`）？
426	**答案**：`monitor=True` 的子进程一旦非零退出就被视为崩溃（[cluster.py:238-240](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/cluster.py#L238-L240)）；`start_task` 专门承载「有限期的启动子进程」，其退出码由 `check()` 单独汇报（[cluster.py:199-201](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/cluster.py#L199-L201)）。driver 走 `run_child`（不进 children 列表、逐秒 `check()`）：driver 的失败要有自己的清理与失败记录路径，而不是被当作「被监管子进程崩溃」一刀切。
427	
428	**练习 3**：driver 为什么要专门 `await startup.wait_ready("judges")`，而不是在起 judge 的地方同步等待？
429	**答案**：准备模型/数据是 CPU+IO 工作，与 judge 加载（占自己的 GPU）互不依赖。cluster 侧用探针子进程并行检测就绪（[cluster.py:422-425](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/cluster.py#L422-L425)），driver 侧在首次发布后才等 judge（[driver.py:193-196](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/driver.py#L193-L196)，注释："GPU initialization and initial publication can finish while qualification runs"），把串行等待压缩成并行流水。
430	
431	## 5. 综合实践
432	
433	把本讲四个模块串成一份「run 生命周期 Runbook」。产物是一份 Markdown 笔记，包含四部分：
434	
435	**任务 A：三阶段输入输出表**。对照 `execute`（[workflow.py:349-426](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/workflow.py#L349-L426)）与 [docs/miles/workflow.md](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/docs/miles/workflow.md)，填写：
436	
437	| 阶段 | 输入 | 输出（写到哪里） | 中断后可否复用 | 判据 |
438	| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
439	| 模型准备 | `model.source`（HF 或 native） | `<conversion.hf_output>` + `workflow-model.json` | 身份一致即复用 | `model_identity` 清单 |
440	| 数据准备 | `data` + HF 目录 | `prepared/data/` + manifest | （结合 u8-l4 的清单与标记） | ? |
441	| 训练 | `RunConfig` + resume checkpoint | `checkpoints/`、`rollouts/`、`workflow.json` | 从 `core-latest.json` 续训 | 指纹 + `clock.next_rollout_id` |
442	
443	并用自己的话回答：**中断后哪些阶段可跳过、哪些必须重算？**（要点：指纹匹配 + 产物标记完整 → 模型/数据直接复用；训练阶段从最新 checkpoint 恢复，未消费的提示组再生。）
444	
445	**任务 B：完成判定追踪**。写一份 200 字左右的说明：epoch 预算 run（无显式 `num_rollouts`）如何被判定为 complete。必须覆盖四个数据点：编译期不补 `num_rollout` 默认值、`save_final_checkpoint` 的默认链、driver 返回字典里的 `num_rollout` 从哪来、workflow L415-423 四个析取条件各对应什么场景。
446	
447	**任务 C：验证**。运行：
448	
449	```bash
450	uv run pytest open_instruct/test_miles_epoch_budget.py -v
451	uv run pytest open_instruct/test_miles_grading_consumers.py -v -k "registry_preflight"
452	```
453	
454	把每条断言映射回任务 B 说明中的一个数据点（例如 `assert "save_interval" not in compiled.miles` ↔ 「不发明周期存档节奏」）；预检用例映射回任务 D。若断言失败，回到 4.3.3 / 4.2.3 对照源码找原因。
455	
456	**任务 D：预检调用点定位（本轮更新）**。在 [driver.py:43-48](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/driver.py#L43-L48) 找到 `validate_registry` 的调用点，写一段说明回答：① 预检的触发门槛为什么要求 `custom_rm_path` 指向 open-instruct 的两个奖励入口？② 它为什么必须发生在 `wiring.launch_worker_manager`（[driver.py:102-103](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/driver.py#L102-L103)）之前——从资源成本与「静默错判 vs 显式报错」两个角度展开（参考 4.2.5 练习 3 的答案自行组织语言）。
457	
458	## 6. 本讲小结
459	
460	- `workflow.execute` 把一次 run 分成准备/训练/收尾三阶段；run 身份 = 规格字典排序 JSON 的 SHA-256，resume 时只有运维字段（重试、缓存、存档/评估节奏）允许变动，模型/数据/训练视野必须严格一致。
461	- `driver.train` 是单次尝试的协调循环：启动预检 → 取 batch → 优化器更新 → 存档边界 → 权重发布 → 评估分发；池耗尽、不可恢复的时间停、跑满预算三种情况算完成，debug 退出与可恢复时间停只算 stopped。
462	- 完成判定的右侧使用 `result.get("num_rollout", ...)`——epoch 预算的 rollout 总数由原生运行时在数据加载后解析，driver 把它带回；`training.num_epoch` 与 `num_rollouts` 互斥，编译期不再补默认 100。
463	- `core.save_final_checkpoint`（CoreConfig 字段）在 epoch 预算 + `save_checkpoints=true` 时默认置真，driver 在最后一个 rollout 落盘最终存档，替代缺失的周期 `save_interval`。
464	- **本轮更新**：`driver.train` 在分配任何 worker 之前调用 `rewards.validate_registry`（新增 `reward_registry_validation` 计时阶段）——逐名解析可信注册表、为每个验证器计算 GradingPolicy，`reward_final_answer_only` 模式下拒绝未声明输入契约的外部验证器，`reward_reasoning_mode="none"` 时拒绝需要思考文本的验证器，把「静默错判」提前变成启动期显式失败。
465	- `cluster.Supervisor` 用统一启动预算、双贴心跳（写自己 + 查对端）、judge 三连失败判死和失败文件传播，把「多副本任何一个失联」变成全体有序失败，再交给 Beaker 重试与指纹恢复闭环。
466	
467	## 7. 下一步学习建议
468	
469	- **u8-l4（数据源、混合、超长排除与源准备）**：本讲把 `prepare_data` 当黑盒，下一讲拆开它——mixture 混合、验证目标绑定与 `data.over_length` 排除策略。
470	- **u8-l12（统一判分输入：ResponseParts、GradingPolicy 与 typed 奖励组件）**：本讲只把 `validate_registry` 当作启动期守门人；下一讲深入它校验的契约本身——`split_response` 的思考边界切分、objective × scope × require_response 的组合约束与 schema 2 证据隔离。
471	- **u8-l6（MILES 奖励体系）**：注册表运行时分发、数学验证器隔离与命名裁判的完整图景，是本讲预检对象的「运行时版」。
472	- **u8-l8（启动、提交与运维）**：本讲的 `cluster.run` 之上还有 launch/submit 把 run 编译成 Beaker 实验；`status` 与回执目录是运维视角的完成判据。
473	- **源码延伸**：[open_instruct/miles/execution/rendezvous.py](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/rendezvous.py) 与 [open_instruct/miles/execution/startup.py](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/startup.py)（attempt 会合与就绪门槛），配合 [docs/miles/operations.md](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/docs/miles/operations.md) 判断 run 是否真正完成。

# 工作流与执行：driver、workflow 与集群启动

> 本讲对应 MILES 单元第三讲。上一讲（u8-l2）我们已经看过 TOML run 文件如何被 `RunSpec` 「加载即编译」成 `RunConfig`；本讲顺着这条链往下走：**编译产物交给谁、在 GPU 集群上如何被执行、中断之后如何恢复、一次 run 何时才算「完成」、以及训练开始前有哪些启动期预检**。本轮增量更新（bae4209 → 8cd7c9eb）为 driver 新增了 `rewards.validate_registry` 启动预检（PR #2250 统一判分输入的一部分），本讲把它作为 driver 协调循环的第一环纳入讲解。

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 说出一次 MILES run 的三个阶段（准备 / 训练 / 导出）各自的输入输出，以及哪些阶段在中断后可以复用、哪些必须重算。
2. 解释「指纹（fingerprint）」如何支撑 resume：配置身份如何计算、哪些字段的改动被允许、哪些会被拒绝。
3. 读懂 `driver.train` 的协调循环：启动期预检 → rollout 收集 → 优化器更新 → 权重发布 → 存档边界，以及时间停 / debug 退出 / 池耗尽三种提前退出方式。
4. 理解 run 完成判定如何使用 driver 返回值中的 `num_rollout`：`training.num_epoch` 预算的 run 由原生运行时在数据加载后才解析出 rollout 总数，并通过 `core.save_final_checkpoint` 在最后一次更新时落盘最终存档。
5. **掌握本轮更新**：`driver.train` 在分配任何 worker 之前调用 `rewards.validate_registry`——解析可信判分注册表、为每个验证器计算 grading 策略，拒绝未声明输入契约的外部验证器或不兼容的 reasoning 约定。
6. 理解 `cluster.Supervisor` 如何在 Beaker 副本内做受监管启动（心跳、健康探针、启动预算）。

## 2. 前置知识

- **run 文件与 RunSpec（承接 u8-l2）**：一份 TOML 描述模型、数据、训练器、推理引擎与集群分配；`RunSpec.compile()` 把结构化小节翻译成 `CoreConfig`（经 `--olmo-core-config` 传入）和原生 MILES 参数（`--num-rollout`、`--num-epoch` 等）。本讲取其中与「训练预算」「存档节奏」和「判分输入声明」相关的编译产出。
- **rollout（采样回合）**：GRPO 类算法以「一轮采样 + 若干次优化器更新」为基本节奏。一轮收集 `rollout_batch_size × n_samples_per_prompt` 条回答，`global_batch_size` 决定每次更新消耗多少条。
- **可信判分注册表（承接 u8-l6）**：MILES 的奖励不是数据自带的任意代码。`core.reward_config` 指向一份注册表 JSON，把验证器名映射到 `{factory, config, kwargs}` 工厂规格；打分时按样本元数据里的 `verifiers` 名单从注册表取验证器。u8-l12 在此之上定义了每个验证器的 grading 输入契约（objective × scope × require_response）。本讲只关心一件事：**driver 在启动时如何预检这份注册表**。
- **幂等与指纹**：分布式训练会被抢占、被重启。为了让重启后的进程能安全复用上一轮的产物，系统给每个产物记录「身份」（输入的哈希或清单），重启时先核对身份，一致才复用——这就是指纹。
- **Beaker 副本（replica）**：MILES 的多机 run 会被 Beaker 调成多个副本，每个副本在各自节点上跑一个 `cluster` 进程；其中 IP 最小的节点成为 head，只有 head 运行训练 workflow。
- **原生运行时（pinned MILES runtime）**：open-instruct 通过 `--miles` 镜像使用一版钉死的 MILES/Core 运行时。数据集加载、rollout 引擎与优化器执行都发生在那个运行时里；open-instruct 侧的 driver 只做编排。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 workflow 阶段与指纹恢复

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

`workflow.py` 回答的问题是：**「一份 run 规格，如何变成磁盘上一组可恢复的产物？」** 它把一次 run 划分为三个阶段：

1. **准备（prepare）**：把模型源转换/暂存成 HF 目录、把数据准备成带验证目标的提示集，并给两个产物各写一份「身份清单」。
2. **训练（train）**：把编译好的配置交给 driver（见 4.2）执行。
3. **导出/收尾**：driver 返回结果字典，workflow 据此把 run 状态写成 `complete` 或 `stopped`。

「指纹」是这一切的安全网：run 目录里记录了启动时规格的哈希，重启时新规格必须与记录匹配（或在允许的「运维字段」上等价），否则拒绝恢复，逼你换一个新的 `output.root`。这防止了「换数据续训旧目录」这类静默事故。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

```text
execute(spec)
  │
  ├─ run_directory(spec)            # 独占锁 + 身份校验 + attempt 记账
  │    ├─ flock(.workflow.lock)     # 多进程互斥
  │    ├─ fingerprint(spec) == 旧 spec_sha256 ?  # 否则按白名单归一化后再比
  │    ├─ 旧 status == complete ? → 拒绝（已完成 run 不可覆盖）
  │    └─ auto_resume=false 且目录已存在 ? → 拒绝
  │
  ├─ 阶段1 准备：prepare_model → prepare_data → 判分注册表校验
  │    （模型/数据产物带身份清单，resume 时直接复用）
  │
  ├─ 阶段2 训练：auto_resume 且有 core-latest.json → 挂载 load；
  │    train_config() → parse_runtime() → driver.train()
  │
  └─ 阶段3 收尾：按结果字典判定 complete / stopped，写 workflow.json
```

指纹的数学定义很直接——对规格字典做「按键排序后的 JSON 序列化」再取 SHA-256：

\[
\mathrm{fingerprint}(d) = \mathrm{SHA256}\big(\mathrm{json\_dumps}(d,\ \mathrm{sort\_keys}=\text{true})\big)
\]

注意 `sort_keys=True` 保证了同一逻辑规格（字典键顺序不同）得到同一指纹。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

**run 目录的锁与身份校验**。[open_instruct/miles/execution/workflow.py:306-346](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/workflow.py#L306-L346) 是 `run_directory` 上下文管理器：先用 `fcntl.flock` 对 `.workflow.lock` 加非阻塞独占锁（防止两个进程同时写同一 run 目录）；然后计算当前规格的指纹，与 `workflow.json` 里记录的 `spec_sha256` 比对；若旧状态是 `complete` 直接拒绝（完成的 run 不可覆盖）；若 `launch.auto_resume=false` 且目录已有 workflow 也拒绝。任何阶段抛异常时，把状态更新为 `failed` 并记录错误再上抛。

**指纹计算（含 OPD 历史兼容）**。[open_instruct/miles/execution/workflow.py:38-44](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/workflow.py#L38-L44) 在哈希前对 OPD 算法的 run 做了两处剔除（空的 `miles` 覆盖表、`keep_checkpoints`），让历史上可选的字段不改变 run 身份。

**允许 resume 时改动的字段白名单**。[open_instruct/miles/execution/workflow.py:58-97](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/workflow.py#L58-L97) 的 `recovery_configuration_matches`：先严格比对原始哈希；不一致时读取磁盘上的 `run-spec.json` 做认证（记录的规格也要能算出旧指纹，防篡改），然后把**运维性字段**从新规格「领养」进记录再比较——包括 `launch.auto_resume` / `max_retries` / `memory`、编译器缓存各项、`training.save_interval` 与 `evaluation.interval`。换句话说：**恢复策略、缓存位置、存档/评估节奏可以改；模型、数据、训练视野（horizon）、算法配方不能改**。

**重启记账**。[open_instruct/miles/execution/workflow.py:107-128](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/workflow.py#L107-L128) 的 `record_attempt`：Beaker 对被抢占任务会无限重启，一个总在存档前被抢占的 run 会永远空转。每次启动向 `attempts.json` 追加一条记录，超过 `launch.max_retries` 即拒绝再启动（`-1` 关闭上限，且「重试次数」不含首次启动）。

**模型身份清单与准备复用**。[open_instruct/miles/execution/workflow.py:131-149](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/workflow.py#L131-L149) 的 `model_identity` 不对几十 GB 的权重做哈希，而是记录每个文件的路径、大小、纳秒级 mtime，仅对小文件（`.json` / `.jinja` / `.metadata`）算 SHA-256；[open_instruct/miles/execution/workflow.py:179-190](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/workflow.py#L179-L190) 里 `prepare_model` 用目标目录下的 `workflow-model.json` 标记：身份一致且产物清单完整 → 直接复用；身份变化或目录不完整 → 报错要求换新 `output.root`。数据准备（`prepare_data`，见 u8-l4）走同样的「清单 + 标记」思路。

**三阶段总编排**。[open_instruct/miles/execution/workflow.py:349-426](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/workflow.py#L349-L426) 的 `execute`：

- L352-353 `prepare_model`（阶段一·模型），L356-378 `prepare_data` + 判分注册表校验（阶段一·数据）；
- L396-398：`auto_resume=true` 且 checkpoint 目录存在 `core-latest.json` 时，把它挂到 `config.miles["load"]`，实现「从最新完成的 Core checkpoint 续训」；
- L399-403：写 `resolved-plan.json`、发 advisories，状态改为 `training`；
- L404-412：调用 `train_config`（内含 `parse_runtime` 与 `driver.train`，见 4.2/4.3）；
- L413-423：完成判定（见 4.3.3）。

**训练前的运行时解析**。[open_instruct/miles/execution/workflow.py:267-303](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/workflow.py#L267-L303)：`parse_runtime` 临时替换 `sys.argv` 调用原生 MILES 的 `parse_args`，并要求后端必须是 `olmo_core`；若带 `--load` 恢复，则从 checkpoint 的 resume manifest 里取出 `clock.next_rollout_id` 作为 `start_rollout_id`——这就是「rollout 游标不重不漏」的来源。

#### 4.1.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：不改任何代码，梳理一次 run 会在 `output.root` 里留下哪些文件，并验证 CPU 侧的配置检查可用。

1. 通读 `execute`（上文链接），把下表填完整（参考要点见第 5 节综合实践的任务 A）：

   | 文件 | 写入者（函数/行号） | 阶段 | resume 时的用途 |
   | --- | --- | --- | --- |
   | `run-spec.json` | ? | ? | ? |
   | `plan.json` / `resolved-plan.json` | ? | ? | ? |
   | `workflow.json` | ? | ? | ? |
   | `attempts.json` | ? | ? | ? |
   | `prepared/`、`checkpoints/`、`inference-profile.json` | ? | ? | ? |

2. 在仓库根目录运行（CPU 即可，不需要 GPU/WEKA）。注意：维护示例本轮起按模型家族重组进了 `tiny/` 与 `small/` 子目录，文档中的命令也已同步（[docs/miles/workflow.md:28-31](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/docs/miles/workflow.md#L28-L31)）：

   ```bash
   python -m open_instruct.miles plan configs/miles/examples/tiny/dev.toml
   python -m open_instruct.miles validate configs/miles/examples/tiny/dev.toml
   ```

3. **需要观察的现象**：`plan` 打印解析后的 argv、批几何与放置；`validate` 只做 CPU 侧检查，不证明显存可容纳（见 [docs/miles/workflow.md:33-38](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/docs/miles/workflow.md#L33-L38)）。
4. **预期结果**：两条命令都以退出码 0 结束；`plan` 输出里能看到 `--num-rollout`（tiny/dev.toml 用显式 rollout 预算 `num_rollouts = 4`，而非 epoch 预算）。
5. 本地未实际运行以上命令，具体输出格式**待本地验证**（行为依据源码与文档）。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `recovery_configuration_matches` 允许改 `training.save_interval`，却不允许改 `training.num_epoch`？
**答案**：`save_interval` 只影响「未来产物的节奏」，不改变已经训出的权重语义；而 `num_epoch` 属于训练视野（horizon）——改了它等于改变这次 run 要训多少数据，与目录里已记录的指纹身份冲突。源码注释明确写了「Keep training horizon, evaluation tasks/scorers, and all recipe fields strict」（[workflow.py:86-88](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/workflow.py#L86-L88)）。

**练习 2**：一个 run 在第 3 次被抢占后重启，`launch.max_retries=2`，会发生什么？
**答案**：`record_attempt` 读到 `attempts.json` 已有 3 条记录，`len(attempts) > limit`（3 > 2）成立，抛出 `InputError`，提示要么调大 `launch.max_retries` 要么换新 `output.root`（[workflow.py:119-125](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/workflow.py#L119-L125)）。注意上限按「重启次数」计，首次启动不会被拒。

**练习 3**：为什么 `model_identity` 不对 safetensors 权重整体做 SHA-256？
**答案**：权重动辄几十 GB，每次启动都全量哈希会把恢复拖慢到不可用。它退而记录（路径, 大小, mtime_ns）三元组，只对小体积的配置/模板文件做内容哈希——以极小概率漏检「同大小同时间的权重替换」换取可用的启动速度（[workflow.py:131-149](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/workflow.py#L131-L149)，函数 docstring 自述 "without hashing tens of GB"）。

### 4.2 driver 协调循环

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

`driver.py` 的 `train()` 是**一次训练尝试（attempt）**的协调者。它自己不执行模型前向、不搬运权重——那些属于钉死的 MILES 运行时（SGLang 推理引擎 + OLMo-core 训练器）。driver 的职责是把各角色连起来并在正确的时机放置边界：

- **启动期预检（本轮新增）**：在分配任何 worker 之前校验判分注册表的输入契约；
- rollout 收集（推理引擎按当前策略采样）；
- 优化器更新（训练器消费一个 batch）；
- 权重发布（把训练器的新权重推给推理引擎，支持 barrier / refresh / engine-drain 三种模式）；
- 存档边界（周期存档、最终存档、哨兵文件触发）；
- 评估与后台评估的分发；
- 无论成功失败都要做的有序清理。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

`driver.train` 的主干可以概括成下面的伪代码（省略 async 细节）：

```text
train(args):
    校验 Ray 后端
    若配置了 reward_config 且 custom_rm_path 指向 open-instruct 奖励入口:
        validate_registry(args)            # ← 本轮新增：worker 分配前的注册表预检
    解析时间预算 max_run_seconds → deadline；判定时间停是否可恢复(resumable)
    启动 Ray → 初始化 W&B → 启动 worker manager
    （colocate/offload 时序约束下）启动 serving 与 trainer；拿到 rollouts_per_epoch
    首次权重发布 publish()；等待 judge 就绪
    for rollout_id in range(start_rollout_id, num_rollout):     # ← 主循环
        batch = manager.get(rollout_id)            # 池耗尽则存档并 break
        learner.train(rollout_id, batch)           # 优化器更新
        completed.append(rollout_id)
        若满足存档条件: manager.save + learner.save_model + finalize_checkpoint
        若 refresh 模式 / 到更新间隔: publish(rollout_id)
        若到评估间隔: evaluation.dispatch(rollout_id)
        若到时间预算: break（resumable 与否决定 final_stop）
        若 debug_exit_after_rollout 达到: break
    收尾：评估 drain、最终 HF 导出、后台评估 final 分发
    finally：按序清理（prepared batch → 生成停止 → 权重传输关闭 → 各角色 dispose）
    return {completed_rollout_ids, num_rollout, pools_exhausted, ...}
```

存档条件的判定（对应 [driver.py:306-324](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/driver.py#L306-L324)）是四项的析取：

\[
\text{save} \iff (\text{到时且可存}) \ \lor\ \text{sentinel} \ \lor\ (\text{save\_final\_checkpoint} \land \text{最后一个 rollout}) \ \lor\ \text{周期 interval 到达}
\]

#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：时间停（`max_run_seconds` 到达）什么时候算 run 完成、什么时候算可恢复中断？
**答案**：driver L65 `resumable = not max_run_final and bool(save)`。有存档路径且未设 `max_run_final` 时，时间停保存后 break，返回 `stopped_for_time=True, time_stop_resumable=True`，workflow 判定为 `stopped`（可 resume）；反之 `final_stop=True`，会做最终导出，workflow 判定为 `complete`。

**练习 2**：为什么 debug 退出（`debug_exit_after_rollout`）不触发最终 HF 导出？
**答案**：L351-353 注释说明：debug 停留下的是「可恢复的 workflow」；如果第一个进程创建了最终导出目录，被 resume 的第二个进程就无法把自己的新权重导到同一目录（导出器是独占的）。所以导出条件是 `reached_end or final_stop`，debug 停两者都不满足。

**练习 3（本轮更新）**：为什么 `validate_registry` 必须发生在 worker 分配（`wiring.launch_worker_manager`）之前，而不是推迟到第一次打分时才发现问题？
**答案**：三个理由层层递进。（1）**时序**：调用点在 `ray.init`、worker manager、W&B 初始化之前（[driver.py:43-48](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/driver.py#L43-L48) 早于 [driver.py:94-103](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/driver.py#L94-L103)），失败时不留任何需要清理的资源。（2）**成本**：若推迟到打分期，GPU 已分配、模型已加载、SGLang 引擎已起，错误在深达数分钟到数小时的初始化之后才出现，且每个打分 worker 都会各自失败一次。（3）**可观测性（最关键）**：有些契约违规不是异常而是**静默错判**——外部验证器在 final-only 模式下二次切分思考边界会拿到空输入，奖励全零、零方差组被过滤、训练空转，打分期根本不会「发现」（[rewards.py:343-346](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/rewards/rewards.py#L343-L346) 注释里点名的 qualified-IF 全零事故）。预检把这类错误变成启动期的显式 `ValueError`。

### 4.3 完成判定与最终存档：epoch 预算如何被判定为 complete

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

此前的更新引入了 **epoch 预算**：研究者可以用 `training.num_epoch = N` 声明「把数据训 N 遍」，而不必先算出这对应多少个 rollout。这带来两个必须解决的工程问题：

1. **完成判定**：workflow 之前拿 `config.miles["num_rollout"]` 与完成计数比对。epoch 预算的编译产物里**故意没有** `num_rollout`（数据集没加载，总数未知），旧的比较永远比不出「到达终点」。解法：原生运行时在数据加载后把解析出的总数写回 `args.num_rollout`，driver 在返回字典里带上它，workflow 优先使用返回值。
2. **最终存档**：rollout 预算的 run 靠 `save_interval`（默认等于 `num_rollout`，即只在结尾存一次）拿到最终权重；epoch 预算没有这个锚点，于是新增 `core.save_final_checkpoint`，由编译器默认置真，driver 在最后一个 rollout 落盘。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

```text
TOML [training] num_epoch=2
   │ run_spec.py L551-552 兜底 put("miles.num_epoch")（num_epoch 不在 FIELD_MAP/CORE_FIELDS）
   ▼
miles.num_epoch=2，且 miles.num_rollout 不存在
   │ L736-740：两者同设 → InputError；只设 epoch → 不再默认补 num_rollout=100
   ▼
L788-795：save_checkpoints=true（默认）且无 num_rollout
   → core.save_final_checkpoint = True（不发明周期 save_interval）
   ▼
RunConfig.arguments()：--num-epoch 2（无 --num-rollout）；
save_final_checkpoint 随 --olmo-core-config JSON 进入 args.olmo_core
   ▼
原生运行时加载数据集 → 解析 num_epoch 为 num_rollout（写入 args.num_rollout）
   ▼
driver 主循环跑满 num_rollout：L311 在最后一个 rollout 存档
   ▼
driver 返回 {"num_rollout": args.num_rollout, ...}
   ▼
workflow.execute：completed[-1]+1 == result["num_rollout"] → status=complete
```

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

**预算二选一**。[open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py:736-740](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/run_spec.py#L736-L740)：`num_epoch` 与 `num_rollout` 同时设置直接 `InputError`（"Choose num_epoch or num_rollouts; MILES would otherwise ignore num_epoch"——防止用户以为 epoch 生效实际被忽略）；只设 `num_epoch` 时**不再**补默认 `num_rollout=100`（旧版这个默认值无条件写入，正是 epoch 预算此前不可用的原因）。

**新 CoreConfig 字段**。[open_instruct/miles/configuration/config.py:84-85](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/config.py#L84-L85)：`save_final_checkpoint: bool = False`，注释定位为「epoch 派生预算、无周期存档节奏时的 driver 策略」；它在 [config.py:239-264](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/config.py#L239-L264) 的布尔字段校验表中（L244），并经 [config.py:819-840](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/config.py#L819-L840) 的 `arguments()` 随 `--olmo-core-config` 的 JSON 传给运行时，最终出现在 driver 眼中的 `args.olmo_core.save_final_checkpoint`。`num_epoch` 的正整数校验在 [config.py:649-651](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/configuration/config.py#L649-L651)（`0`、负数、`true` 都被拒——注意 Python 里 `True` 是 `int`，所以这里显式检查 `type(...) is not int`）。

**driver 侧的最终存档与返回值**（已在 4.2.3 展开，这里只点名）：[driver.py:311](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/driver.py#L311) 的第三个存档触发条件与 [driver.py:437-445](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/driver.py#L437-L445) 返回字典中的 `num_rollout`。

**workflow 的完成判定**。[open_instruct/miles/execution/workflow.py:413-423](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/workflow.py#L413-L423)：

```python
completed = result.get("completed_rollout_ids") if result else None
complete = (
    completed is None
    or bool(result.get("pools_exhausted"))
    or (bool(result.get("stopped_for_time")) and not result.get("time_stop_resumable"))
    or (
        (completed[-1] + 1 if completed else result["start_rollout_id"])
        == result.get("num_rollout", config.miles.get("num_rollout"))
    )
)
```

四个条件的语义：① driver 没有报告完成清单（视为完成，兼容旧返回）；② 命名池耗尽（数据用尽即目标达成）；③ 不可恢复的时间停（终局停）；④ 完成计数 +1 达到总数。**关键在第④项右侧**：`result.get("num_rollout", config.miles.get("num_rollout"))`——driver 返回的、由原生运行时在数据加载后解析出的总数优先；编译配置里的 `num_rollout` 只是旧运行时的回退。epoch 预算 run 正是靠第④项右侧的新值被正确判为 complete。判定后 [workflow.py:424-425](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/miles/execution/workflow.py#L424-L425) 把 `complete`/`stopped` 与整个结果字典写进 `workflow.json`——而 4.1 里「已 complete 的 run 不可重启」正是消费这个状态。

**测试佐证**。[open_instruct/test_miles_epoch_budget.py:10-36](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/8cd7c9eb4e4d997cd482e9f88f5249d081728d9a/open_instruct/test_miles_epoch_budget.py#L10-L36) 是这条链的验收：`num_epoch=2` 编译后 `miles["num_epoch"]==2` 且**没有** `num_rollout`；argv 含 `--num-epoch` 不含 `--num-rollout`；`compiled.core.save_final_checkpoint` 为真且无 `save_interval`；`training.num_rollouts` 与 `num_epoch` 并存、`num_epoch ∈ {0,-1,True}` 均抛 `ValueError`；`save_checkpoints=false` 时 `save_final_checkpoint` 不再默认为真。
